title: SU(3) Gell-Mann Fierz completeness as defining-representation reconstruction
expression_sketch: Gell-Mann generators lambda_a, a in {1,...,8}, as explicit 3x3 traceless Hermitian matrices (Wikipedia Gell-Mann matrices; lambda_8 = (1/sqrt(3)) diag(1,1,-2)). Color/fundamental indices alpha,beta,gamma,delta in {1,2,3}. Trace orthonormality: Tr(lambda_a*lambda_b) = 2*delta(a,b). Product law: lambda_a*lambda_b = (2/3)*delta(a,b)*I_3 + Sum_{c=1}^{8} (d_abc + I*f_abc)*lambda_c. Fierz completeness (Wikipedia recast form; Haber 2021 eq. (6) for T=lambda/2): Sum_{a=1}^{8} lambda_a(alpha,beta)*lambda_a(gamma,delta) == 2*delta(alpha,delta)*delta(beta,gamma) - (2/3)*delta(alpha,beta)*delta(gamma,delta). Equivalent T-normalization: Sum_a T_a(i,j)*T_a(k,l) = (1/2)*(delta(i,l)*delta(j,k) - (1/3)*delta(i,j)*delta(k,l)) with T_a = lambda_a/2 and i,j,k,l in {1,2,3}. Casimir check: Sum_a lambda_a*lambda_a = (16/3)*I_3.
latent_structure: Invariant bilinear reconstruction of the su(3) defining representation: the eight Gell-Mann generators plus I_3 span M_3(C), and the completeness identity rewrites the index-swap operator on C^3 tensor C^3 as a linear combination of Kronecker products. BASIS_RECONSTRUCT, not a dummy-index rename and not the su(2) Pauli Fierz (2x2, three generators).

function_domains.lambda: The eight Gell-Mann 3x3 traceless Hermitian matrices with Wikipedia's explicit entries and lambda_8 coefficient 1/sqrt(3).
function_domains.delta: Kronecker delta on the indicated finite index set ({1,2,3} or {1,...,8}).
function_domains.f_abc: Totally antisymmetric SU(3) structure constants, f_abc = -(I/4)*Tr([lambda_a,lambda_b]*lambda_c), with f_123=1.

nonzero_conditions.statement: N=3 is nonzero, so the coefficients 1/3 and 2/3 in the completeness identity are defined in Q.
nonzero_conditions.label: DECLARED
nonzero_conditions.source: Haber, SciPost Phys. Lect. Notes 21 (2021), eq. (6) with N=3; Wikipedia Gell-Mann Fierz completeness

positivity_conditions.statement: sqrt(3) in lambda_8 is the positive real square root.
positivity_conditions.label: DECLARED

branch_conventions: sqrt in lambda_8 is the principal nonnegative real square root; only sqrt(3) appears.
source_provenance: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gell-Mann_matrices (explicit matrices; product law; Fierz completeness relations, recast form Sum_a lambda^a_{alpha beta} lambda^a_{gamma delta} = 2 delta_{alpha delta} delta_{beta gamma} - (2/3) delta_{alpha beta} delta_{gamma delta})
H. E. Haber, Useful relations among the generators in the defining and adjoint representations of SU(N), SciPost Phys. Lect. Notes 21 (2021), arXiv:1912.13302, eq. (6).
M. Gell-Mann, The Eightfold Way, CTSL-20 (1961); Gell-Mann and Ne'eman, The Eightfold Way, Benjamin 1964.
Particle Data Group, Review of Particle Physics, SU(3) isoscalar factors and representation matrices (lambda product law).

derived_conditions.statement: The nine matrices {I_3, lambda_1, ..., lambda_8} are a C-basis of M_3(C) and an R-basis of Hermitian 3x3 matrices; completeness is the component form of that Hilbert-Schmidt expansion.
derived_conditions.label: DECLARED
derived_conditions.source: Wikipedia Gell-Mann matrices, Fierz completeness paragraph; Haber 2021 derivation of eq. (6)

derived_conditions.statement: lambda_a = 2 T_a converts Haber eq. (6) into the Wikipedia lambda-form of Fierz completeness.
derived_conditions.label: DERIVED
derived_conditions.source: T_a = lambda_a/2, Wikipedia and Haber normalizations Tr(lambda_a lambda_b)=2 delta_ab vs Tr(T_a T_b)=(1/2) delta_ab

public_source: Wikipedia Gell-Mann matrices Fierz completeness; Haber SciPost Lect. Notes 21 (2021) eq. (6); Gell-Mann CTSL-20
why_not_cse_lgg: The left-hand side is a sum of eight Kronecker products of 3x3 generator components; the right-hand side is a two-term combination of Kronecker deltas on swapped color indices. CSE cannot invent the su(3) generator basis. LGG has no 3x3 matrix-algebra constructor. Distinct from the 2x2 Pauli completeness identity.
proposer_leak_risk: Hide Fierz, Gell-Mann, su(3), d-symbol, structure constants, completeness. Show only the summed generator bilinears in color indices, not the Kronecker reconstruction.
notes: Finite matrix identity over C. Algebraic; no analytic continuation. Distinct from AC TEST ac-t-pauli-completeness (SU(2), spinor indices in {1,2}, three Paulis). N=3 is declared, not a silent specialization of general SU(N).
